title: Class 8 Mathematics: Ratio and Proportion
description: A 20-question practice quiz on simplifying ratios, equivalent ratios, proportion, unitary method, direct proportion and inverse proportion, prepared for Sonali Dalei.
instructions: The timer is set to 20 minutes and starts when you begin the quiz.
Your result will be calculated automatically after submission.

questions.text: What is the simplest form of the ratio 18:24?
Two numbers are in the ratio 4:7 and their sum is 55. What is the smaller number?
If 5 notebooks cost ₹150, what is the cost of 8 notebooks at the same rate?
Which ratio is equivalent to 6:9?

questions.category: Dividing a Quantity in a Given Ratio
questions.text: Divide 96 in the ratio 5:7. What are the two parts?
If x:21 = 2:3, what is the value of x?
If 2:5 = 10:x, what is the value of x?
Eight workers complete a job in 15 days. How many days will 12 workers take at the same rate?
On a map, 1 cm represents 1 km. What actual distance is represented by 3 cm?
If 2.5 kg of apples cost ₹200, what is the cost of 4 kg at the same rate?
What is the ratio of 45 minutes to 2 hours in simplest form?
Find the fourth proportional to 3, 5 and 7.
What is the mean proportional between 9 and 25?
If 5:8 = 15:x, what is the value of x?
Which pair of quantities is generally in direct proportion when the rate per item is fixed?

options.A: Number of items and total cost
options.B: Speed and time for a fixed distance
options.C: Number of workers and days for a fixed job
options.D: Side length and perimeter of a fixed square

questions.text: For a fixed distance, if speed increases, what happens to the time taken?

options.A: It increases in the same ratio

questions.text: The ratio of boys to girls in a group is 4:7. If there are 56 girls, how many boys are there?
Milk and water are mixed in the ratio 5:2. If there are 14 litres of water, how much milk is present?
Twelve workers finish a job in 20 days. How many days will 15 workers take at the same rate?
Three machines make 180 parts in 4 hours. How many parts will 5 identical machines make in 6 hours?
